activeCluster.name: Pittsburgh corridor evidence-gate rebuild
activeCluster.reason: South Florida's next inland Broward candidates remain deferred for representative reusable photography after Okeeheelee Nature Center cleared release. The rollout now follows the completed Philadelphia corridor west to Pittsburgh, replacing legacy quantity-first destination pages that recycled parent photos or used approximate positions.
activeCluster.releaseStandard: Retain official parent answers, require three to four current representative reusable photographs per released parent, and publish only named subsites with exact reviewed coordinates, destination-specific photography, and current operator guidance.
